title: 才 vs 就 Step 1 · Early Bird or Late? 就 vs 才 with Time
description: Time + 就 = earlier than expected, time + 才 = later than expected. 他六点就来了 vs 他十点才来 — same clock, opposite feelings.

points.title: Time + 就 = earlier than expected 🐇
points.summary: 就 after a time word: it happened sooner than you'd think.
points.body:
- 他六点**就**来了。 He came as early as six.
- 我五分钟**就**做完了。 I finished in just five minutes.
- 她十八岁**就**结婚了。 She got married at just 18.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He came as early as six in the morning.

points.title: Time + 才 = later than expected 🐢
points.summary: 才 after a time word: it happened later than you'd think — 'not until'.
points.body:
- 他十点**才**来。 He didn't come until ten.
- 我做了三个小时**才**做完。 It took me three hours to finish.
- 她三十五岁**才**结婚。 She didn't marry until 35.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He didn't come until ten at night.

questions.prompt: 「{会议|huìyì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāishǐ}，{他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。」 — how does the speaker see it?
notes: 八点 is before nine — and 就 stresses 'early'.
questions.translation: The meeting starts at nine — he was there by eight.

questions.prompt: 「{会议|huìyì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāishǐ}，{他|tā}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{到|dào}。」 — how does the speaker see it?
notes: Ten is an hour after nine.
questions.translation: The meeting started at nine — he didn't arrive until ten.

questions.prompt: {电影|diànyǐng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāishǐ}，{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěnme}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}（　）{来|lái}？
notes: 就 = early — but you're an hour late.
questions.translation: The film started at seven — why are you only coming at eight?

questions.prompt: Same clock, different feeling: is the speaker saying 'early' or 'late'?
items: {会议|huìyì}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāishǐ}，{他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: **就** = sooner / quicker / younger than expected; **才** = later / slower than expected.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}（　）{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
notes: 就 = quick — but it was hard.
questions.translation: This problem was so hard — it took me two hours to finish.

questions.prompt: 'She was already married at 18.' Which sentence says so?
questions.explanation: Young / early → time + **就** + verb + 了.
notes: 就 goes after the time word.

questions.prompt: 'He didn't get up until noon.' Which sentence says so?
notes: 才 goes after the time word.
questions.translation: He didn't get up until noon.

questions.prompt: Same clock, different feelings: 「{他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{起床|qǐchuáng}{了|le}。」 vs 「{他|tā}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{起床|qǐchuáng}。」
options: First: 8 is early for him. Second: 8 is late for him.
Both mean he gets up at 8 — no difference.
questions.explanation: 就 = **earlier** than expected; 才 = **later** than expected.
notes: The time is the same — the speaker's feeling is opposite.
就 = quickly — but it took ages (半天).
questions.translation: I searched for ages before I found my keys.

notes: 才 = 'not until three' — but the ！ says 'that young!'.
questions.translation: My little brother could swim at just three!
